card.title: THE BOY WHO READ THE WIND

captions.text: The sky tears open over the final battlefield.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta! Wake up! Asta!
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Asta falls. The world goes silent.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Church bells. Cold sheets. Small, trembling hands.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Same bed. Same church. Same ceiling.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta was never supposed to have magic.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He was supposed to wait fifteen years in the dirt for a miracle.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: What if he remembered everything?
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Spade raid. The betrayals.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The brother trapped inside the wall of Hage's tower.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: At six years old?
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The wind in Hage comes down off the demon skull. Nobody ever thinks about it twice.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta thinks about nothing else.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He stands at the church fence, eyes closed, and feels the air lean.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ki. The breath and the heartbeat of the world.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A body with no magic can still learn to hear it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The air shifts.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Three seconds later, Yuno's gust slams the laundry line, and every sheet snaps.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: You looked at the sheets before my wind even moved.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Lucky guess.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Yuno is six, and still a crybaby. Last time Asta mocked him for it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: This time he hands him a handkerchief.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I was not crying. It was the wind.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Of course it was.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Why are you being nice to me? It is strange.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Consider it an investment.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: It confuses everyone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The loudest child in Hage has gone quiet, and he watches everything.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then Sister Lily crosses the yard, and an old habit wakes up on its own.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sister Lily. Marry me.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Oh, Asta. You know the rule.
captions.speaker: SISTER_LILY

captions.text: He feels her weight shift a heartbeat early.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: For the first time in history, Asta steps aside.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It missed. Lily's fist missed! That has never happened!
captions.speaker: FATHER_ORSI

captions.text: Oh my. Asta, you are growing up so fast.
captions.speaker: SISTER_LILY

captions.text: At seven, Asta asks Yuno for a blindfold.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then he asks him to throw everything he has.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Wind blades. Pebbles. A gust meant to knock him flat.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He slips between them like smoke.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: How did you know?
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Throw harder.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: You breathe in before you cast.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Yuno goes very still. He is not used to being the one who is behind.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then I will learn not to. I will be Wizard King first.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Try it. I am still going to beat you there.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Season after season, he trains the only thing nobody can take from him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And every night, he climbs to the roof and looks at the grimoire tower.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Because he knows what is sleeping in its wall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And he knows how long it has been waiting.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Age ten. Midnight. The grimoire tower is empty, and Asta knows which stone to press.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He needs no lantern. He follows the draft, cold and thin, to a crack in the wall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Behind the cracked stone lies a filthy, tattered book.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Five leaves. He has waited four years to touch it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: His fingers close on the cover. The tower disappears.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Black water. No floor. No sky.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Something vast turns over in the dark, and it is hungry.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Chains of old black light hang from nowhere, and every one of them is aimed at him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A magicless brat. Walking right into my mouth. How convenient.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Devils hate humans. I hate you most. I will be wearing you by morning.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Asta does not raise a hand. He does not reach for a weapon. He just looks up.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Why are you not afraid, boy?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Your name is Liebe.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Who told you that? Nobody knows that.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Your mother named you. Her name was Licita.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Do not say that name.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Licita. She held you until the very end.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: I said do not.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: The dark shudders. Claws that were closing stop, trembling, an inch from his face.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: She died. She sealed me in this filth and died. What do you know?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: That she chose you. Every single time.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Nothing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: For a long time, only the sound of something enormous trying not to breathe.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: She was my mother too.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: No. That is not possible.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: She left me at a church door so I would live.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Who are you?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Your brother. And I am late.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Last time, I was fifteen years late.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Last time? What does that mean?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Later. First, let me sit down.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: What do you want from me?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: To sit here for a minute. With my brother.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: You are the stupidest human I have ever met.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Probably. I have been told.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Outside, the dawn bell rolls over Hage.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta climbs out of the tower with dust on his hands and no fear at all.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Behind him, in the wall, a devil lies still for the first time in years.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Not trapped. Waiting.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Five years.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By day, Ki footwork in the fields until his legs shake and the wind tells him everything.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By night, he sits against the tower wall and talks.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: About bread. About Yuno. About the sky.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Today Yuno tried to cut a tree. The tree won.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: You are boring me to death, human.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Then why do you answer?
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: I am trapped. Echoes are all I get.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: The book will not open before the ceremony.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: So Asta waits, again, and this time he is not waiting alone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Make the contract. Master and servant. That is how it works.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: No. Equals, or nothing.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Tch. Fine. As if I care.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Fifteen. The tower hall is packed with trembling children.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Yuno steps forward, and a four-leaf grimoire answers him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then it is Asta's turn. Nothing. No light, no book.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Only laughter, rolling across the hall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They are laughing at you. Does that not bother you?
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: Not anymore. I know how this ends.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Exactly as before, down to the last giggle. And this time, Asta smiles.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the road home, Revchi steps out of the trees, chains hissing at his wrists.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He wants Yuno's grimoire.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He does not notice the magicless boy already standing behind him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Revchi. Chain Magic. Thrown out of the Purple Orcas in disgrace.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: What? Magicless trash like you has no right to
captions.speaker: REVCHI

captions.text: Skip it.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Behind them the tower groans. A crack tears up the wall, and the stone gives way.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The five-leaf grimoire rips itself free and tears across the sky,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: straight for his hand.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hurry up, partner. I am getting bored.
captions.speaker: LIEBE

captions.text: The Demon-Slayer Sword drops into his hand. One swing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Revchi's chains do not break. They simply stop existing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: My chains. What did you do to my chains?
captions.speaker: REVCHI

captions.text: You have been hiding something since we were six.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Only a few things.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Fine. Keep them. Just leave me an enemy next time.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Then be faster.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: I was letting you have it.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: The Royal Capital. Banners, towers, ten thousand voices.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Every hopeful in the kingdom, packed into one arena.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And across the field, a man in black, cigarette burning low. Yami Sukehiro. Alive.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta's breath catches. He remembers how that man was taken.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And now he is standing right there, yawning.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kid. Why are you looking at me like I died?
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: No reason.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Stop it. It is creepy.
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: Sorry. Long story.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: His match lasts one breath.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Asta reads the swing, steps inside it, and ends it with one move.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That was a good read, brat. Where did you learn it?
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: A very patient teacher.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Tch. Whoever he is, he owes me a drink.
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: The arena goes silent. Then one hand goes up.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then another. Hands that never went up before.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Listen, brat. The Black Bulls are not exactly
captions.speaker: YAMI

captions.text: Black Bulls. Yes.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: Across the arena, Yuno signs with the Golden Dawn.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Their eyes meet. Neither looks surprised.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Do not fall behind.
captions.speaker: YUNO

captions.text: Do not trip.
captions.speaker: ASTA

captions.text: On the arena floor, Asta closes his eyes.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The captains' box becomes a map of heartbeats.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He knew where to look. William Vangeance sits very still.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And inside him, two breaths. Two lives. One body.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He files it away, like a coin saved for later.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Above them all, Wizard King Julius Novachrono tilts his head.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He is watching the boy.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Oh? This boy's time does not move like ours. Someone wound it back.
captions.speaker: JULIUS

captions.text: How interesting.
captions.speaker: JULIUS

captions.text: And Asta, for the first time, reaches out with Ki toward the Wizard King.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A heartbeat. Then, beside it, another. Two people in one man.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And one of them has just turned to look at him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And that one knows Asta was never meant to be here.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Part Two begins with a question he cannot answer.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Who sent him back, and what are they waiting for?
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Stay with us. The wind has already changed.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR
